_about: Memento tier map: the ladder of Claude Code model aliases and the roles pinned to RANKS on it. Owned by the framework canon; each instance carries a byte-identical copy that its doctor hash-checks. Human-edited, John-verified. Read by memento/tools/agent-tier-gate.py (the spawn gate) and memento/tools/generate_agents.py (agent definitions). Nothing outside the ladder is ever allowed. See plan-spawn-tier-control-across-estates-2026-09-06.

verified_against.hook_fields: Agent: tool_input.model, tool_input.subagent_type, tool_input.prompt. Workflow: tool_input.script | scriptPath | name. tool_input.model on Agent is undocumented in hooks.md and proven by the witness; if it vanishes the witness goes red.

memento-scout.description: Read-only evidence gatherer for Memento-governed work. Use for multi-file recon, large log/test-output scanning, repo pattern searches, and doc/capability extraction. Returns concise cited findings; never edits, never decides.

memento-implementer.description: Bounded implementer for Memento-governed work. Use ONLY with a settled spec (files, exact changes, verification steps). Makes the specified changes, verifies, reports a contract; never expands scope, never makes design decisions, never commits.

memento-reviewer.description: Adversarial reviewer for Memento-governed work. Use before presenting an artefact or diff to John. Isolated context, assumes failure, demands forensic evidence; reviews against spec and Memento principles; read-only; PASS/NEEDS-CHANGES verdict with evidence.
